image.name: bambustudio
image.description: [Bambu Studio](https://bambulab.com/en/download/studio) is an open-source, cutting-edge, feature-rich slicing software. It contains project-based workflows, systematically optimized slicing algorithms, and an easy-to-use graphical interface, bringing users an incredibly smooth printing experience.

changelog.desc: Ingest from pre-release, make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Rebase to Ubuntu Noble to ingest approved appimage.
Rebase to Selkies, HTTPS IS NOW REQUIRED.
Add required fonts and environment variable for dark mode.
Update Readme with new env vars.
Fix printer camera by ingesting Fedora Appimage, Add program icon for PWA ingestion.

env_vars.name: DARK_MODE
env_vars.desc: Set this to true to enable dark mode for Bambu Studio.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores program settings and files.

ports.desc: Bambu Studio desktop gui HTTP, must be proxied.

image.title: Bambustudio
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  bambustudio:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/bambustudio:latest
    container_name: bambustudio
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - DARK_MODE=true #optional
    volumes:
      - /path/to/bambustudio/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=bambustudio \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -e DARK_MODE=true `#optional` \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/bambustudio/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/bambustudio:latest
